prediction_text: Direction: Canterbury (Archbishop Laud) shall die a VIOLENT death by a sharp weapon — beheading by sword/axe — not a natural death in prison. Mars is the key: the Sun in a fiery sign applies to opposition of Mars, the dispositor of the aged Bishop, Mars is in an airy and humane sign (a public, human-inflicted death), and the Moon wants seven degrees of the body of Mars while applying to the Sun near the cusp of the eighth (death house). His significator Saturn is in fall, long retrograde, in the twelfth (prison) — a ruined, imprisoned man with no rescue testimony. Timing: the Moon's seven degrees to Mars give a months-scale coordinate (about seven units on a month scale for a fate question) to the violent end.
basis: Cusp 9th taken for his Asc (churchman); Saturn lord thereof in fall long retro in 12th = prison/ruin; Moon sep Saturn applying Sun near 8th cusp; Sun fiery applying opp Mars dispositor of bishop; Mars airy humane sign; Moon wanting 7d of Mars body. Lilly: Mars + 8th house application in humane sign = death by weapon at men's hands.
